notes.title: New release! Get WRECKIN' BALL ADVENTURE! 30% OFF now!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32149778/b976def2bac5caf32a3e58032b84f27202f8f612.jpg

Hello everyone!

We are very happy to announce WRECKIN' BALL ADVENTURE - a brand new release by No Gravity Games!

Wreckin' Ball Adventure is a family-friendly platformer for up to 4 players, with ball-shaped robots and physics-based puzzles. 
You are a ball to jump, swing and wreck your way to freedom!

Get it 30% OFF now!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/746030/Wreckin_Ball_Adventure/

BTW, for all Nintendo Switch fans, the game is also available: https://www.nintendo.com/games/detail/wreckin-ball-adventure-switch/

notes.title: Huge update is out now!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32149778/d22e9df60fa910eea1a96012db771d52a62102ea.jpg

We made some changes and added extra assets for you:

1. A completely new menu. 
2. 2 new avatars: Industrial and TrashPro.
3. 2 skins for Industrial and 3 for TrashPro.
4. 5 new skins for Units: Cthulhu, ER, The Great Women's, Halloween, Goth 
5. 10 new puzzles.
6. 10 new titles.
7. Steam Achievements.
8. Steam Cards.
9. Energy system for puzzles is turned off. Players don't need it anymore.


Enjoy! And let us know your feedback :)
